notablePrerequisites: Karlov of the Ghost Council has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Karlov of the Ghost Council using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Karlov of the Ghost Council triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
